# Code Modification - Build System: Integrate pinned upstream SDKs without global flags or configure-time downloads.
# Scope: SDK targets and aliases. Performance: profiling and future SDKs are opt-in; no engine features are activated here.
# Toggles: WISEENGINE_ENABLE_PROFILING, WISEENGINE_ENABLE_VULKAN, WISEENGINE_BUILD_ASSET_TOOLS, WISEENGINE_ENABLE_FUTURE_SDKS.
set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS OFF CACHE BOOL "Build static SDK libraries" FORCE)
set(BUILD_TESTING OFF CACHE BOOL "Disable upstream test suites" FORCE)
set(THIRDPARTY_ROOT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")
# Keep Git ownership exceptions confined to this explicit SDK tree and this process.
if(DEFINED ENV{GIT_CONFIG_COUNT})
    set(ce_git_config_index "$ENV{GIT_CONFIG_COUNT}")
else()
    set(ce_git_config_index 0)
endif()
set(ENV{GIT_CONFIG_KEY_${ce_git_config_index}} "safe.directory")
set(ENV{GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_${ce_git_config_index}} "${THIRDPARTY_ROOT}/*")
math(EXPR ce_git_config_count "${ce_git_config_index} + 1")
set(ENV{GIT_CONFIG_COUNT} "${ce_git_config_count}")
function(ce_sdk name)
    if(NOT EXISTS "${THIRDPARTY_ROOT}/${name}/CMakeLists.txt")
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Missing SDK ${name}. Run: python cmake/FetchThirdParty.py")
    endif()
    add_subdirectory("${THIRDPARTY_ROOT}/${name}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/${name}" SYSTEM EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
endfunction()

set(FMT_TEST OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(FMT_INSTALL OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
ce_sdk(fmt)
add_library(ThirdParty::fmt ALIAS fmt)
set(SPDLOG_FMT_EXTERNAL ON CACHE BOOL "Use the same fmt ABI as the engine" FORCE)
set(SPDLOG_BUILD_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SPDLOG_BUILD_EXAMPLE OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SPDLOG_INSTALL OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
ce_sdk(spdlog)
add_library(ThirdParty::spdlog ALIAS spdlog)
set(YAML_CPP_BUILD_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(YAML_CPP_BUILD_TOOLS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(YAML_CPP_INSTALL OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
ce_sdk(yaml-cpp)
add_library(ThirdParty::yaml-cpp ALIAS yaml-cpp)

set(SDL_SHARED OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SDL_STATIC ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SDL_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SDL_TEST_LIBRARY OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SDL_INSTALL OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)

add_library(ThirdParty::SDL ALIAS SDL3-static)

set(GLM_BUILD_LIBRARY OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)

add_library(ThirdParty::glm ALIAS glm)

set(ENKITS_BUILD_EXAMPLES OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(ENKITS_BUILD_C_INTERFACE OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
ce_sdk(enkiTS)
add_library(ThirdParty::enkiTS ALIAS enkiTS)

if(NOT EXISTS "${THIRDPARTY_ROOT}/boost/boost_1_88_0/boost/predef.h")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Boost headers are missing. Run: python cmake/FetchThirdParty.py")
endif()
add_library(ce_boost INTERFACE)
target_include_directories(ce_boost SYSTEM INTERFACE "${THIRDPARTY_ROOT}/boost/boost_1_88_0")
add_library(ThirdParty::Boost ALIAS ce_boost)
add_library(ce_stb INTERFACE)
target_include_directories(ce_stb SYSTEM INTERFACE "${THIRDPARTY_ROOT}/stb")
add_library(ThirdParty::stb ALIAS ce_stb)
add_library(ce_asio INTERFACE)
target_include_directories(ce_asio SYSTEM INTERFACE "${THIRDPARTY_ROOT}/asio/include")
target_compile_definitions(ce_asio INTERFACE ASIO_STANDALONE _WIN32_WINNT=0x0A00 NOMINMAX WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN)
target_link_libraries(ce_asio INTERFACE ws2_32 mswsock)
add_library(ThirdParty::asio ALIAS ce_asio)

set(PHYSFS_BUILD_SHARED OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(PHYSFS_BUILD_STATIC ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)

add_library(ThirdParty::physfs ALIAS physfs-static)
set(LUAU_BUILD_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)

set(OVERRIDE_CXX_FLAGS OFF CACHE BOOL "Preserve the parent compiler/CRT policy" FORCE)
set(USE_STATIC_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY OFF CACHE BOOL "Use /MD and /MDd consistently" FORCE)
set(DOUBLE_PRECISION ${WISEENGINE_JOLT_DOUBLE_PRECISION} CACHE BOOL "Use double world positions for large worlds" FORCE)
set(INTERPROCEDURAL_OPTIMIZATION OFF CACHE BOOL "Avoid cross-SDK LTO coupling" FORCE)
set(ENABLE_ALL_WARNINGS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(ENABLE_INSTALL OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
foreach(feature SSE4_1 SSE4_2 AVX AVX2 AVX512 LZCNT TZCNT F16C FMADD)
    set(USE_${feature} OFF CACHE BOOL "Portable baseline; specialize after measuring")
endforeach()
add_subdirectory(JoltPhysics/Build "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/JoltPhysics" SYSTEM EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
add_library(ThirdParty::Jolt ALIAS Jolt)
set(TRACY_ENABLE ${WISEENGINE_ENABLE_PROFILING} CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)

set(TRACY_STATIC ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
ce_sdk(tracy)
add_library(ThirdParty::Tracy ALIAS TracyClient)
add_library(ce_miniaudio STATIC integration/miniaudio.c)
target_include_directories(ce_miniaudio SYSTEM PUBLIC "${THIRDPARTY_ROOT}/miniaudio")
add_library(ThirdParty::miniaudio ALIAS ce_miniaudio)

set(JSON_BuildTests OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(JSON_Install OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
# Match Diligent's JSON ABI configuration in every engine-facing translation unit.
set(JSON_Diagnostics ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)

add_library(ThirdParty::json ALIAS nlohmann_json)

set(BUILD_TOOLS ${WISEENGINE_BUILD_ASSET_TOOLS} CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(BUILD_SAMPLE OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(BUILD_DX11 OFF CACHE BOOL "Disable deprecated DX11 code" FORCE)
set(BUILD_DX12 ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(BC_USE_OPENMP OFF CACHE BOOL "Avoid adding a second parallel runtime" FORCE)
ce_sdk(DirectXTex)
add_library(ThirdParty::DirectXTex ALIAS DirectXTex)
if(WISEENGINE_BUILD_ASSET_TOOLS)
    add_custom_target(WiseEngineAssetTools DEPENDS gltfpack texassemble texdiag Luau.Compile.CLI Luau.Analyze.CLI)
endif()

set(DILIGENT_BUILD_SAMPLES OFF CACHE BOOL "Samples/media are not runtime SDK dependencies" FORCE)
set(DILIGENT_BUILD_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(DILIGENT_BUILD_TOOLS ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(DILIGENT_BUILD_FX ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(DILIGENT_NO_DIRECT3D11 ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(DILIGENT_NO_OPENGL ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(DILIGENT_NO_METAL ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(DILIGENT_NO_WEBGPU ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(DILIGENT_NO_ARCHIVER ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(DILIGENT_NO_RENDER_STATE_PACKAGER ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
if(WISEENGINE_ENABLE_VULKAN)
    set(DILIGENT_NO_VULKAN OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
else()
    set(DILIGENT_NO_VULKAN ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
endif()
set(DILIGENT_INSTALL_CORE OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(DILIGENT_INSTALL_TOOLS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(DILIGENT_INSTALL_FX OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(DILIGENT_MSVC_RELEASE_COMPILE_OPTIONS "" CACHE STRING "Preserve the baseline CPU instruction set" FORCE)
if(NOT EXISTS "${THIRDPARTY_ROOT}/python-runtime/Scripts/python.exe")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Local code-generation Python is missing. Run: python cmake/FetchThirdParty.py")
endif()
set(Python3_EXECUTABLE "${THIRDPARTY_ROOT}/python-runtime/Scripts/python.exe" CACHE FILEPATH "Project-local SDK code generation" FORCE)
# Upstream runs pip during configure; all required packages are already staged locally.
set(ENV{PIP_NO_INDEX} "1")
set(ENV{PIP_NO_CACHE_DIR} "1")
set(ENV{PIP_DISABLE_PIP_VERSION_CHECK} "1")
ce_sdk(DiligentEngine)
add_library(ce_diligent INTERFACE)
target_include_directories(ce_diligent SYSTEM INTERFACE
    "${THIRDPARTY_ROOT}/DiligentEngine" "${THIRDPARTY_ROOT}")
target_link_libraries(ce_diligent INTERFACE Diligent-GraphicsEngineD3D12-static DiligentFX)
if(WISEENGINE_ENABLE_VULKAN)
    target_link_libraries(ce_diligent INTERFACE Diligent-GraphicsEngineVk-static)
endif()
add_library(ThirdParty::Diligent ALIAS ce_diligent)
add_library(ThirdParty::imgui ALIAS Diligent-Imgui)

if(NOT EXISTS "${THIRDPARTY_ROOT}/dxc/bin/x64/dxc.exe")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "DXC is missing. Run: python cmake/FetchThirdParty.py")
endif()
add_executable(ThirdParty::dxc IMPORTED GLOBAL)
set_target_properties(ThirdParty::dxc PROPERTIES IMPORTED_LOCATION "${THIRDPARTY_ROOT}/dxc/bin/x64/dxc.exe")
function(wiseengine_stage_dxc target)
    add_custom_command(TARGET ${target} POST_BUILD
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different
            "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/thirdparty/dxc/bin/x64/dxcompiler.dll"
            "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/thirdparty/dxc/bin/x64/dxil.dll"
            "$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:${target}>"
        VERBATIM)
endfunction()

    set(ozz_build_tools OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(ozz_build_samples OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)

    set(RECASTNAVIGATION_EXAMPLES OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    ce_sdk(recastnavigation)
    add_library(ThirdParty::ozz ALIAS ozz_animation)
    add_library(ThirdParty::Recast ALIAS Recast)
    add_library(ThirdParty::Detour ALIAS Detour)
endif()
